notes.title: Game play updates
notes.notes:
Hello Community! 

We received feedback on some small improvements we could make to help improve the general pace of the game. We appreciate your feedback and always look forward to making Departure Dash more enjoyable. 

[b]Here is the list of improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of aircraft movement. This includes arrival, to the gate, and departure.
[*] Increased the base movement speed of all airport vehicles (Fuel, Bag, and Deice)
[*] Increased the upgrade speed values for all vehicles.
[*] Reduced the loading, refuelling, and deicing wait times by 50%
[/list]

We would love to hear any additional improvements you would like to see added to the game. 

Thanks,
Metawe
